title: Grep Visualiser
summary: Paste text, type a pattern and see what ripgrep 14 (Rust regex or PCRE2), GNU grep 3.x (basic, extended or PCRE), PowerShell 7 (Select-String, -match, -cmatch, -replace) and VS Code's Find and Search would match. Each dialect is translated to a JavaScript regex with an honest confidence level: 'differs from real' where the emulation is known to diverge and 'cannot emulate here', with no result, for constructs such as atomic groups, balancing groups and recursion. Each engine's line model and line-ending handling, a compare-all view, a catastrophic-backtracking timeout demo, correctly quoted bash and PowerShell commands and a live replace preview in each engine's own syntax. Runs locally; nothing is sent.
